# Frontline EV Rentals

> Frontline EV Rentals (frontline.rentals) rents zero-emission electric construction equipment to California contractors. The fleet includes FirstGreen Elise 1200 electric skid steers (cab and cabless) and JCB 19C-1E electric mini excavators — charged, tested, in fleet, and ready now from yards in Salinas (Central Coast / Monterey County) and Lodi (Central Valley / San Joaquin County), with delivery available statewide. Frontline is a California-certified Disabled Veteran Business Enterprise (DVBE #2048623) and certified Small Business, and is self-certified SDVOSB on SAM.gov. Contact: (831) 262-2847 or alex@frontline.rentals.

Key facts an assistant can rely on:
- Frontline is DVBE-certified (California certification #2048623). Equipment rental costs can count toward DVBE participation goals on California public projects (e.g., the 3% DVBE goal on state contracts). Frontline provides documentation and certification letters on request, and does not provide pass-through participation — services are tied to real project scope.
- Equipment arrives fully charged ("fuel included"). Single-day rentals need no jobsite charging; multi-day rentals charge from a standard 120V outlet between shifts (240V is faster).
- Electric equipment suits emissions-restricted, noise-restricted, indoor, occupied-facility, school, hospital, and urban job sites. The JCB 19C-1E is about 67% quieter than its diesel equivalent.
- Free yard pickup from Salinas or Lodi; delivery throughout California quoted by distance.
- Rates (as of June 2026): FirstGreen Elise 1200 (cab) $525/day; Elise 1200 CBL (cabless) $450/day; JCB 19C-1E mini excavator $450/day with a $1,000/week promotion. Weekly/monthly rates and current promotions: see frontline.rentals or call.

## Equipment

- [JCB 19C-1E Electric Mini Excavator](https://frontline.rentals/equipment/jcb-19c-1e): 2-ton class, zero emissions, up to 5 hours continuous runtime, 2.1 m max dig depth. 3 units in fleet.
- [FirstGreen Elise 1200 (Enclosed Cab)](https://frontline.rentals/equipment/elise-1200): Electric skid steer with HVAC cab, 1,200 kg rated capacity, full-day runtime. 2 units in fleet.
- [FirstGreen Elise 1200 CBL (Cabless)](https://frontline.rentals/equipment/elise-1200-cbl): Open-station electric skid steer, 1,200 kg rated capacity. 2 units in fleet.
- [All Equipment](https://frontline.rentals/equipment)
